data.name: Gauntlet
data.description: 54×36″. Red and Blue zones run along opposite long edges, 6″ deep. Markers 1–5, with 5 in the centre.

data.name: Typhoon
data.description: 54×36″. L-shaped corner zones: Red in one corner (24″ along the long edge, 18″ down the short edge, 6″ deep), Blue mirrored in the opposite corner. Markers 1–5.

data.name: Acropolis
data.description: 54×36″. Each player has two 18″×6″ corner zones on opposite diagonals (Red top-left and bottom-right, Blue top-right and bottom-left). Markers 1–5.

data.name: Proving Grounds
data.description: 54×36″. Red holds 6″ strips along both short edges; Blue holds a zone centred on one long edge. Markers 1–5.

data.name: Breach
data.description: 54×36″. Blue along one short edge, Red along the other, each 6″ deep. Markers 1–5.

data.name: Agria Valley
data.description: 36×36″. L-shaped zones in opposite corners (12″ arms, 6″ deep). Markers 1, 2 and 5.

data.name: Abandoned Camp
data.description: 36×36″. Red and Blue along opposite edges, 6″ deep. Markers 1, 2 and 5.

data.name: Dirt Side
data.description: 36×36″. Stepped L-shaped zones in opposite corners (12″ arms). Markers 1, 2 and 5.

data.name: Frontier
data.description: 36×36″. Red has two zones centred on opposite edges; Blue has two zones centred on the other two edges (12″ wide, 6″ deep). Markers 1, 2 and 5.

data.name: Char Plains
data.description: 36×36″. Red and Blue each have an 18″×6″ zone at the same end of opposite edges. Markers 1, 2 and 5.

data.name: Meeting Engagement
data.description: 54×36″. Each player has two zones: an 18″×6″ zone centred on one long edge (Blue on one, Red on the other) and a 12″×6″ zone centred on a short edge (Blue on the left, Red on the right). Markers 1–4 sit 12″ in from each side and 12″ from the long edges (1 and 3 Red, nearest Blue's long edge; 2 and 4 Blue, nearest Red's long edge). 5 is the neutral centre Marker.

data.name: Green Valleys
data.description: 36×36″. Each player has a 12″×6″ zone centred on one side edge (Blue left, Red right) plus a small 6″-deep corner zone (Red top-left, Blue bottom-right). Marker 1 (Red) is 12″ from the left and 6″ from the bottom, Marker 2 (Blue) is 12″ from the right and 6″ from the top, and 5 is the neutral centre Marker.

data.name: One Bridge Too Close
data.description: 54×36″. Each player has an L-shaped zone, 6″ deep, along half of one long edge and down the adjoining short edge (Blue in the top-left corner, Red in the top-right). Markers 1 (Red) and 2 (Blue) are 15″ from the top edge and 18″ from the right and left edges respectively. Markers 3 (Red) and 4 (Blue) are 6″ from the bottom edge and 12″ from the right and left edges. 5 is the neutral Marker, 6″ from the bottom edge on the centre line.

data.name: Power Lines
data.description: 36×36″. Each player has an L-shaped zone, 6″ deep, along half of one edge and down the adjoining side edge (Blue on the left, Red on the right, joining at the centre of the top edge). Markers 1 (Red) and 2 (Blue) are 12″ from the right and left edges and 15″ from the top. 5 is the neutral Marker, 6″ from the bottom edge on the centre line.
